sharedOperatingRules.information:
KEEP source-authorized hidden but established world facts as readable information. An authoritative Director-established fact does not need a pre-existing software log or a caster-known document; conversely, a source file, nonempty story label or fixture is not proof of an actual campaign fact. The spell's scope authorizes disclosure, not invention of an otherwise undefined history, actor, faction or operation. Missing data is not zero, Neutral, nonmembership, absence of a trap or proof of an empty past. Preserve exact fact source, version, time precision and audience separately from the current query.

Read every unprotected fact the individual spell promises; do not reduce all activities/history to one favored record or an arbitrary sample. A specific protection applies only to the information, subject, generating school/rank and time scope it actually covers. Protection of one person does not conceal independent institutional/environmental facts, and protected personal facts cannot be relabeled institution/effect history to evade the protection. Supply independently meaningful readable fields. Indeterminate does not identify the hidden reason, number of withheld records or protection. If existence itself is protected, disclose no placeholder, ID gap, total or count derived from that protected existence. Claim No qualifying fact only where absence itself is established and readable; otherwise do not certify completeness beyond the readable facts. An explicitly permitted masking effect retains its own false/altered-result rule; do not override it with a generic truthful-result assertion.

Equivalent paid inquiries under materially unchanged facts, authority and applicable protections give consistent overlapping information across casters/rephrasing. Genuine new events, changed protections or new established evidence can change later paid answers. Knowledge itself supplies no skill success, disarm, control, consent, authority, spell acquisition or free communication. operationalCandidate.completeProcedure:

NEW exact fallback template, because the supplied combat guide leaves exact templates open: use a cone with 60-foot forward axial length and circular cross-section of diameter equal to distance along its axis (diameter 60 feet at its far end). Record an actual origin and facing vector before the cast. On the existing 5-foot grid, use cell centers in that volume; a body/feature qualifies through a genuinely occupied included cell and only its readable local footprint is disclosed. Do not include a creature merely because an empty corner of its rectangular bounding box touches the volume. Hidden traps: reveal the current physical site, occupied footprint, armed/dormant state and immediate trigger category of every actual readable trap. A concealed plate qualifies; an ordinary dangerous creature is not automatically a trap. No disarm solution, code, future die or automatic Search/disarm Action is granted. Enemies: reveal the current occupied footprint and readable creature count of actual beings presently intending or executing a meaningful hostile act against the caster or a member of the caster's current party. This NEW predicate is not alignment, species, reputation, mere disagreement or a caller's enemy flag. It reads no plan, memory, full identity or stat block. Intent, location and existence protections retain their independent actual scopes; never count protected existences.

Magic: reveal each current actual magical effect's local footprint, spell/nonspell category, generating school/rank when its source supplies them, and active/suppressed state. A dormant enchanted object's still-existing enchantment may be distinguished from an active spell when readable; this does not invent charges, attunement, powers or an absent school/rank. Overlapping effects stay separate. Lies: NEW examine assertions made during the inclusive six elapsed seconds ending at resolution by a creature presently in the readable cone, only where the caster actually perceived and understood that assertion. Report deliberate deception when the speaker knowingly asserted what they then believed false; a sincere error is not a lie. Irony, uncertainty, misunderstood content, mere recorded sounds or a speaker now outside the area create no invented belief or objective replacement truth. Current relevant belief/existence protections still apply. A valid decoded sign can be an assertion; the spell supplies no language or general translation.

No generic save is added. An actual defense's own check/threshold applies only within its source scope. Apply the shared information rule without a free preflight search for hidden facts. The spell disarms, dispels, damages and compels nothing. CORRECTION to the proposal's blanket retained-concealment language: learning a location ends Hidden for this caster and removes Invisible's own attack modifiers against this informed observer, as already reviewed; it does not make an Invisible creature visible or satisfy a sight-required spell. operationalCandidate.completeProcedure:
KEEP self or one ally and exactly two subsequent qualifying attack/spell occurrences. NEW require a willing perceived allied creature, including self, within 120 feet and line of effect; replace the operational Instantaneous shorthand with an attached, nonconcentration ward lasting 60 elapsed seconds from resolution, with two uses and no recipient Reaction. Its existence does not require the caster to remain nearby or conscious after establishment. One operative same-spell family per recipient across casters: a successful new ward replaces the old and discards its remainder. Establishment of this ward is not itself a use-consuming occurrence. A failed/countered new cast does not itself replace an older ward. Rest and token/owner/scene changes replenish nothing.

NEW event identity: one nonspell attack is one occurrence, irrespective of its separate damage types/riders. Distinct Multiattack attacks are distinct occurrences. One spell's immediate resolution is one occurrence per recipient, grouping all that cast's immediate beams/missiles/attacks even when rolled sequentially. Do not count the same spell and its constituent attacks twice. A later real source-scheduled tick, paid maintenance pulse, delayed occurrence or entry occurrence is a separate event, keyed to its actual occurrence ID, not another cast. Mere passive ongoing presence, a stat query or a renamed packet is no occurrence. A spell-associated weapon damage rider in its parent hit is not a second event unless its own source genuinely creates a separate resolution. Distinct actually cast spells inside a composite Action remain distinct casts/occurrences.

Uses are automatic, not optional damage shields. An actual miss, successful save, zero-damage hit or resolving nondamaging beneficial spell still consumes a use. CORRECTION to the proposed universally pre-roll timing: resolve any legal target-substitution window at its existing source timing; automatically commit the use on the attack's actual final recipient before hit/miss consequences and damage, even if the unchanged attack die has already been rolled. There is no post-result choice to save the use. For a spell, commit before that recipient's first actual resolution component. A canceled attack never made, a spell countered before effect resolution, a guessed empty space with no actual recipient, or an area portion excluded by total cover consumes none. Do not charge the abandoned intended target after a genuine retarget.

NEW — first-admission closure and replacement. For each actual spell occurrence and actual recipient, evaluate this ward family’s admission once, immediately before that recipient’s first actual resolution component at the timing specified above. This checkpoint belongs to the occurrence and recipient, not separately to each beam, damage root or ward application. At that checkpoint, the current eligible, live, unsuppressed ward with an available use automatically spends one use and binds that occurrence’s coverage to that exact ward application. If no ward can commit, record no admission and close that occurrence’s admission checkpoint for this recipient without spending a use. Later components of the same occurrence cannot create or reopen admission. Ending suppression, establishing a new ward, or successfully replacing a ward after that checkpoint does not admit the already-started occurrence. A successful replacement terminates the old application under the existing replacement rule and inherits neither its uses nor its admitted-occurrence coverage; the replacement spends no use on that already-started occurrence. Previously prevented damage remains prevented, but subsequent unresolved components receive no prevention from either the terminated application or its replacement. The replacement retains its own two uses and its own deadline of 60 elapsed seconds from establishment for subsequent qualifying occurrences, including genuinely separate source-scheduled occurrences of the same spell. Another actual recipient is evaluated at that recipient’s own first actual component, not when the spell first affected someone else. Existing retargeting, canceled/excluded-event and transfer rules remain unchanged. For a share-only recipient, its first positive pre-mitigation share supplies its first qualifying admission checkpoint; a zero share or post-defense branch explicitly skipping prevention supplies none. A qualifying direct component already resolved for that same recipient closes the checkpoint before any later share of that occurrence.

At the finite-prevention stage, after that recipient's defenses and before post-defense sharing/temp HP, prevent all otherwise eligible damage from the covered occurrence to that recipient. Retain distinct underlying damage roots/rolls; grouping protection does not merge damage packets or create extra Wound/trigger events. Bloodbond/Veinlock pre-mitigation splits first assign the real raw shares. NEW explicit admission for this interface: a positive pre-mitigation share may consume/claim a ward use for its actual recipient against that parent occurrence, without making that recipient hit or transferring nondamage riders; group by original attack/spell occurrence and ward recipient, so that occurrence cannot charge the same ward twice. A zero share creates no share-only occurrence. Each such recipient still has only its own one defense/prevention stage. Post-defense transferred branches explicitly skipping prevention neither consume a new ward use nor receive this prevention, regardless of retained spell/attack provenance. Direct HP payment, HP assignment, environmental falling and nonattack nonspell harm are not eligible by association.

A hit is still a hit; independently applicable control, movement, Maiming, nondamage riders, item damage, lethal assignments and source-specific concentration ending remain. Positive-damage-dependent riders recheck actual remaining damage. Prevention produces no transfer, reflection, stored damage, healing or restored payment. Covered components of the second occurrence remain authorized until that one occurrence finishes, then the depleted ward ends; an unrelated interleaved event gains nothing. Recheck actual ward existence/suppression for each still-unresolved component: a genuine dispel/expiry can stop later components but never undo already prevented damage. Suppression prevents new use commitments during the gap and prevents applying the ward while suppressed; it does not refund a previously committed occurrence use or extend the deadline. After suppression ends, only the same still-live ward application may resume prevention for an occurrence it already admitted before the gap, without spending another use. This includes an occurrence whose commitment spent that ward’s second use, subject to the existing termination rule when that occurrence finishes. Unused uses remain available for other qualifying occurrences at their own admission checkpoints; they do not permit late admission of an occurrence whose checkpoint has passed. Neither continued prevention nor a new commitment operates at or after that application’s expiry, or after its replacement or other termination. Recipient death/destruction, removal or expiry ends it; prior caster death alone does not. The half-open duration excludes new occurrences at the exact deadline.

operationalCandidate.completeProcedure:
KEEP Action/V/S/F/base 17 RP and the caster entering a trance for guidance about one specific question. NEW operational duration: concentration for 60 uninterrupted elapsed seconds from effect resolution, replacing the historical Instantaneous field only in the derived operative layer. At commitment state one specific question and identify one actually perceived creature, object, site or active effect within 120 feet and line of effect to which it materially relates. The caster may be the legitimate self anchor; no different recipient is forced into trance. Range establishes this real local reference, not a cap on every causally relevant fact. No deity, spirit, plane, Voice or hidden cosmological source of the answer is identified.

NEW while the trance effect operates the caster remains conscious, stationary and concentrating, cannot voluntarily move, take Actions/Bonus Actions/Reactions, or deliberately communicate. It is not Stunned, Unconscious, Charmed or hostile whole-turn denial, grants no automatic criticals/failed saves and spends no hostile hard-control allowance. Voluntary ending is possible without an Action; it discards the unfinished inquiry. Actual involuntary movement (including transport that changes position), Incapacitated state, loss of required concentration or suppression of this trance ends it without a partial answer/refund/restart. Damage uses the real concentration save; surviving ordinary damage alone does not necessarily interrupt. Components are performed at the cast commitment, not continuously repeated for the whole minute; later Silence alone does not end otherwise valid concentration. The caster can end the trance before attempting an otherwise legal Reaction, but cannot both retain it and react. Other clocks, provider/custody/resource duties and hazards continue. No rest, training, research progress or other parallel active work is earned from this minute.

At the normal 60-second completion, verify the uninterrupted interval in canonical event order, deliver the answer exactly once and end the trance. Its scheduled completion is not an expiry failure. An interruption committed earlier in the same ordered boundary prevents completion; a later event cannot erase an already completed answer. NEW answer format: one private coherent answer at most 150 words, identifying the central established relevant fact/obstacle and up to three concrete feasible next investigative or practical steps. This is a ceiling, not an obligation to invent three leads. It may disclose genuinely hidden, unprotected relevant facts, not merely repeat the caster's knowledge. Ordinary communication and action on that knowledge remain separately required.

For a present/past question, report supported actual facts at their real precision. For a future decision, NEW use at most the next 30 elapsed days from answer completion: conditional guidance derived from actual actors, capacities, commitments and causal constraints, explaining a crucial uncertainty and how choices can change the outcome. Do not roll future dice, guarantee survival or make a future decision binding. Apply the shared information protections to each actual fact; provide only a real next step whose own information is readable. When nothing useful is established/readable, state that the inquiry supplies no actionable answer, without inventing a lead or disclosing why. Question clarification before commitment validates form/relevance without revealing hidden facts. One committed question cannot split into several new inquiries. Equivalent unchanged inquiries retain the same supported information; a genuinely new question or material evidence/causal change supports a new paid cast. The answer is remembered information, not ongoing tracking, compulsory behavior, legal access or an automatic successful check.

Each readable activity appears once with its actual current objective, participants/roles, location, stage and immediate activity. Include actual distant branches and faction business, including unreported or unauthorized work genuinely using the institution's office, resources or orders. Independent personal/family activity, private unrelated thoughts and unrelated third-party business remain outside it. Shared operations disclose this faction's real participation, not the other institution's whole dossier. Range and originating line of effect admit the local reference; they do not clip the institution-wide remote register.
